blind.description: A shallow circular dish or decorative metallic plate. It features a flat circular center and a raised rim embossed with ornate floral or filigree leaf patterns. The material is a polished, reflective metallic finish (gold/brass tone). Surfaces are solid and continuous, resting flat directly on the ground with no plinth or floating artifacts.
blind.from_above: A circular metallic disc or plate with a flat interior basin surrounded by an ornate decorative embossed rim.
blind.height_vs_figure: Extremely flat, only an inch or two high, with a diameter around 1 foot across (roughly the width of the figure's base).

notes: appears in a gold/brass tone rather than silver
